{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, cream (#EFE6D8), merino wool

Trousers, high-waisted straight cut, full ankle length, charcoal (#3A3F47), brushed wool-blend with a soft lining

Coat, double-breasted, tailored fit, below-knee length, cranberry (#8E1B3A), dense wool-cashmere blend with a quilted warm lining

Ankle boots, low block heel, black (#1C1C1C), waterproof-treated leather with a lugged rubber sole

Socks, tall, heather grey (#8A8D91), thick merino wool

Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, emerald (#0B6E4F), soft wool

Gloves, wrist length, black (#1C1C1C), leather with a cashmere lining

Hat, close-fitting beanie, emerald (#0B6E4F), ribbed wool

This outfit keeps the office look neat and polished with a knit and trousers, while the cranberry coat and emerald accents give her the bold, standout look she wants. The long coat, merino layers, lined trousers, scarf, gloves and hat keep her warm on a 20-minute walk in deep frost. The grippy waterproof boots handle snow and road salt, and the full-length trousers keep salt spray off the hems. Once she takes off the coat, the cream knit and charcoal trousers are calm and professional at her desk."}
